card.name: Words right before 'stake' or 'stakeholder'
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'stake', 'stakes' or 'stakeholder(s)', such as 'at' in 'at stake' or 'each', 'all', 'the' before 'stakeholder'. It appears in project-management advice and in phrases about what is at risk.

modes.label: At stake
modes.description: The word 'at' when the next word is 'stake' in phrases about what is at risk.
modes.example: Given what is<< at>> stake, Rio+20 has become

card.writes: It adds the start of the word stake or stakeholder (st-) as the next piece of text.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'stake' or 'stakeholder', when the model expects that word next.
